parameters.content:
# Classify rental payments and receipt requests from Telegram

## How it works
1. Telegram receives a rental-related message.
2. A router checks whether the message is a full /receipt command, a receipt request, a receipt date reply, or a general rental tracking message.
3. Receipt messages are parsed and returned as demo receipt summaries.
4. General rental messages are sent to OpenAI and classified as payment, cost, booking_summary, or unknown.
5. Valid parsed results are sent back to Telegram as a demo output.

## Setup
- [ ] Add your Telegram credential to the Telegram Trigger and Telegram reply nodes.
- [ ] Add your OpenAI credential to the model node.
- [ ] Update the OpenAI prompt with your property names, currency, and payment-message format.


## Customize
This is a lite demo template. To use it in production, connect the parsed outputs to your own storage, reporting, or receipt-generation service.

# Telegram intake and router

Receives each Telegram message and routes it to the correct receipt or tracking path.

# Full receipt command

Parses a complete /receipt message and replies with the extracted client receipt details ( stay, amount, and number)

# Receipt from last payment

Lets the user reply "receipt" after a payment SMS. The workflow checks the latest stored payment and asks for stay dates. The user can then reply "24 June to 28 June 2026" and receives a receipt-ready summary.

# AI rental classifier

Sends normal rental messages to be classified by OpenAI, then converts the response into clean fields.

# Demo output

Valid entries are returned as demo outputs. Payment messages are also saved temporarily so the receipt flow can use them.

# Required credentials

This workflow will not run until you connect your own Telegram and OpenAI credentials. The template does not include any production backend, private URL, API key, or live database.

# Stay date reply

Combines the saved payment with the guest’s stay dates and returns either a receipt-ready summary or a clear error.

## Who this is for

Built for small short-term rental owners and co-hosts who manage payments and bookings through Telegram. It is especially useful in African markets where mobile-money payment messages are common, but it can be adapted for any rental business across the world.
